artworks.label: Sea glass crab
artworks.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. ONE new original standalone square1024x1024 Glaze small-widget illustration for sea-glass-sunday. One small whimsical shore crab sculpted from softly frosted pale-aqua sea glass, rounded mint-green body with subtle sea-worn translucence, warm-ivory shell-like claws and little clear glass legs, two tiny dark pearl eyes, a few cream sand grains at its feet. Sophisticated coastal collectible craft photography, tactile frosted glass, warm beach daylight, seafoam/aqua/ivory/sand palette. No bottle, starfish, sand dollar, wind chime or large shell. Whole subject centered, compact readable silhouette, generous18percent empty margins. Truly transparent empty background, alpha preserved; no opaque tile, floor, frame, border or collage. Pure illustration only: absolutely no text, lettering, numerals, dates, clocks, hands, dials, calendars, UI, logos or watermark. Entirely new art, never copy/crop/recolour an existing image.
artworks.processing: Resize entire original square to 1024x1024; WebP q90 method4; alpha preserved; no crop, recolour or subject edits.
artworks.visualReview: Reviewed against wallpaper and all current pure-art subjects; distinct subject, matching style/palette, no text or live-value imagery.
